result.answer: The records combine as 12 cartons × 8 units per carton = 96 units originally shipped. Subtracting the 3 transit-damaged, unusable units gives 93 usable units remaining. Limitation: this is the count implied by the supplied records; they do not establish whether any other losses, shortages, or unusable units exist.
